sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Govindpur P.S. Case No.220 of 2024,
registered for the offence punishable u/s 376, 313 of IPC.

3. Allegedly, the petitioner established physical relation with the victim on the pretext of marriage and when victim asked him for marriage, he refused to marry her and he along with one other co-accused person have assaulted the victim.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and has not committed any offence.
He has been falsely implicated in this case due to ulterior motive.

As per FIR, occurrence took place on 01.07.2022 and the FIR has been lodged on 19.07.2024 i.e after the delay of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.82451 of 2024(2) dt.11-12-2024 about two years without any valid explanation for the said delay which casts serious doubt regarding prosecution story.
It is further submitted that victim is a major and physical relation has been established with the consent of the victim.

5.
